jp: 人間に介護されなければまともに生きられない貧弱ドジっ子だったが、品種改良によって逆に人間を介護できるくらいには健康に。恩返しをしようと懸命に羽をパタパタさせて近寄ってくる。元々、自力で生きられない身体にしたのは人間なのだが知らぬが仏。
jp_grezzo: "人間に介護されなければまともに生きられない貧弱ドジっ子だったが、品種改良によって逆に人間を介護できるくらいには健康に。恩返しをしようと懸命に羽をパタパタさせて近寄ってくる。元々、自力で生きられない身体にしたのは人間なのだが知らぬが仏。"
en: They were weak and unfit to live without being cared for but through breeding they became healthy enough to take care of humans. They come closer fluttering their wings as hard as they can to return the favor. Originally it was human beings who made them unable to live on their own but they don't know this.
en_grezzo: "They were weak and unfit to live without being cared for but through breeding they became healthy enough to take care of humans. They come closer fluttering their wings as hard as they can to return the favor. Originally it was human beings who made them unable to live on their own but they don't know this."
it: Era una creatura gracile e imbranata che senza le cure degli umani non sapeva campare, ma la selezione della specie ha rovesciato la faccenda: adesso sta così bene in salute da poter assistere lei gli umani. Per sdebitarsi ti viene incontro sbattendo le ali con tutta la forza che ha. A ridurla a un corpo che da solo non stava in piedi erano stati proprio gli umani, ma lei non lo sa, e beata lei.

jp: 他力本願な芋虫。狙われないように伏せたままほとんど動かず、誰かが敵を倒してくれるのを待っている。敵が近づくと慌てて応戦する。他の昆虫兵器たちからの評判も悪く、ちゃんと働いてくれと怒られている。
jp_grezzo: "他力本願な芋虫。狙われないように伏せたままほとんど動かず、誰かが敵を倒してくれるのを待っている。敵が近づくと慌てて応戦する。他の昆虫兵器たちからの評判も悪く、ちゃんと働いてくれと怒られている。"
en: A self sufficient caterpillar. He stayed prone almost motionless to avoid being targeted and waits for someone to take down the enemy. When the enemy approaches it fights back in a flurry. The other insect weapons have a poor opinion of him and he is scolded for doing his job properly.
en_grezzo: "A self sufficient caterpillar. He stayed prone almost motionless to avoid being targeted and waits for someone to take down the enemy. When the enemy approaches it fights back in a flurry. The other insect weapons have a poor opinion of him and he is scolded for doing his job properly."
it: Un bruco che campa sul lavoro degli altri. Sta disteso e quasi immobile per non farsi prendere di mira, e aspetta che sia qualcun altro ad abbattere il nemico. Se il nemico gli arriva addosso, si mette a rispondere al fuoco tutto trafelato. Anche fra le altre armi-insetto ha pessima fama, e lo sgridano perché faccia la sua parte.

jp: 中身だけ抜き取られて放置された宝箱に、自我が芽生えた。空っぽな自分を埋めるために人を食らい続け、小さな村を２つ壊滅させた過去を持つ。ゼミ創始者に敗れて無理やりマスコットにされたが、今は結構満たされた日々を送っているらしい。
jp_grezzo: "中身だけ抜き取られて放置された宝箱に、自我が芽生えた。空っぽな自分を埋めるために人を食らい続け、小さな村を２つ壊滅させた過去を持つ。ゼミ創始者に敗れて無理やりマスコットにされたが、今は結構満たされた日々を送っているらしい。"
en: His soul was caught up by a treasure chest that had been plucked clean of its contents and abandoned. He has a history of devouring people to fill his empty self and destroying two small villages. He was defeated by the founder of the seminar and was made a mascot forcibly but now he seems to be living a pretty fulfilling life.
en_grezzo: "His soul was caught up by a treasure chest that had been plucked clean of its contents and abandoned. He has a history of devouring people to fill his empty self and destroying two small villages. He was defeated by the founder of the seminar and was made a mascot forcibly but now he seems to be living a pretty fulfilling life."
it: In uno scrigno a cui avevano portato via solo il contenuto, e che poi era stato abbandonato lì, germogliò una coscienza. Per riempire il proprio vuoto andò avanti a divorare gente, e ha alle spalle due piccoli villaggi rasi al suolo. Sconfitto dalla fondatrice del Seminario, fu fatto mascotte a forza, ma pare che oggi passi giornate abbastanza appagate.

jp: 冒険者生活が面白いと聞き自分もなってみたのはいいが、色々と複雑で混乱している。注意力が散漫で、体調の悪さに気が付かなかったり説明を読み飛ばしたり注釈を見落としたり固有名詞を間違えて覚えたりする。
jp_grezzo: "冒険者生活が面白いと聞き自分もなってみたのはいいが、色々と複雑で混乱している。注意力が散漫で、体調の悪さに気が付かなかったり説明を読み飛ばしたり注釈を見落としたり固有名詞を間違えて覚えたりする。"
en: They heard that the adventurer life is interesting so they tried it but it's complicated and confusing. they have a distracted attention span failing to notice how unwell they are skimming descriptions missing annotations and memorizing proper nouns incorrectly.
en_grezzo: "They heard that the adventurer life is interesting so they tried it but it's complicated and confusing. they have a distracted attention span failing to notice how unwell they are skimming descriptions missing annotations and memorizing proper nouns incorrectly."
it: Ha sentito dire che la vita dell'avventuriero è divertente e ha voluto provarci anche lui, il che va benissimo, se non fosse che è tutto complicato e lui ci si perde. Ha l'attenzione che gli va dove vuole: non si accorge di stare male, salta le spiegazioni, si lascia sfuggire le note e i nomi propri se li impara sbagliati.

jp: 赤い剣を携えたアルバイト。ちゃんと研修やマニュアルがあるらしい。報酬は歩合制。この先生に指導を受けた者たちの中には、後でバイトと知ってびっくりする者も多い。
jp_grezzo: "赤い剣を携えたアルバイト。ちゃんと研修やマニュアルがあるらしい。報酬は歩合制。この先生に指導を受けた者たちの中には、後でバイトと知ってびっくりする者も多い。"
en: A part-time job with a red sword. Apparently there's proper training and manuals. Compensation is commission-based. Many of those who were instructed by this teacher were surprised to learn later that they were part-time workers.
en_grezzo: "A part-time job with a red sword. Apparently there's proper training and manuals. Compensation is commission-based. Many of those who were instructed by this teacher were surprised to learn later that they were part-time workers."
it: Un lavoratore a ore, con la spada rossa in dotazione. Pare che ci siano davvero un periodo di addestramento e un manuale. Il compenso è a provvigione. Fra quelli che hanno ricevuto la lezione da questo maestro, in molti restano di sasso quando poi scoprono che era un ragazzo a ore.

jp: 昔、赤剣先生のバイトをしていた経験があり、そこから興味を持ってゼミ講師になった。他の講師と互いにあだ名で呼び合うことを提唱し、結構馴染んでいる。密かに同じ講師のアジタリオのことが気になっている。
jp_grezzo: "昔、赤剣先生のバイトをしていた経験があり、そこから興味を持ってゼミ講師になった。他の講師と互いにあだ名で呼び合うことを提唱し、結構馴染んでいる。密かに同じ講師のアジタリオのことが気になっている。"
en: She used to work as a part-time teacher for Red Sword Sensei and that's when she became interested in becoming a seminar teacher. She advocates calling each other by nicknames with other instructors and they are quite familiar with each other. She is secretly concerned about a fellow lecturer Ajetalio.
en_grezzo: "She used to work as a part-time teacher for Red Sword Sensei and that's when she became interested in becoming a seminar teacher. She advocates calling each other by nicknames with other instructors and they are quite familiar with each other. She is secretly concerned about a fellow lecturer Ajetalio."
it: Un tempo ha fatto l'aiutante a ore del maestro Spada Rossa, e da lì le è venuta la voglia di insegnare al Seminario. È stata lei a proporre che i docenti si chiamassero per soprannome, e la cosa ha attecchito parecchio. Di nascosto le interessa Ajetalio, che insegna lì come lei.

jp: 現役時代から、戦士たちの質の低下を憂いていた。娘が一人前になったのをきっかけに実家の道場を継がせて、自分は根本的なところから指導を行うべくゼミ講師となった。
jp_grezzo: "現役時代から、戦士たちの質の低下を憂いていた。娘が一人前になったのをきっかけに実家の道場を継がせて、自分は根本的なところから指導を行うべくゼミ講師となった。"
en: Even while on active duty he was concerned about the declining quality of warriors. When his daughter became a full-fledged member of the family he let her take over his family's dojo and I became a seminar instructor to teach her from a fundamental point of view.
en_grezzo: "Even while on active duty he was concerned about the declining quality of warriors. When his daughter became a full-fledged member of the family he let her take over his family's dojo and I became a seminar instructor to teach her from a fundamental point of view."
it: Già ai tempi in cui era in attività si rammaricava di come calasse la qualità dei guerrieri. Quando la figlia si è fatta adulta le ha lasciato il dojo di famiglia, e lui si è messo a insegnare al Seminario per prendere la faccenda dalle fondamenta.

jp: 昔はザナン軍で広報担当をしていたが、自分に合わないと思いゼミ講師に転職。アイテムマニアで、自宅には様々なコレクションがあるとの噂。ただの散歩のつもりが、アイテム収集に発展することが多々ある。
jp_grezzo: "昔はザナン軍で広報担当をしていたが、自分に合わないと思いゼミ講師に転職。アイテムマニアで、自宅には様々なコレクションがあるとの噂。ただの散歩のつもりが、アイテム収集に発展することが多々ある。"
en: He used to work as a communications officer for the Zanan Army but decided it wasn't the right fit for him so he became a seminar instructor. He is an item enthusiast and is rumored to have a variety of collections at home. What was meant to be just a walk often turned into a collection of items.
en_grezzo: "He used to work as a communications officer for the Zanan Army but decided it wasn't the right fit for him so he became a seminar instructor. He is an item enthusiast and is rumored to have a variety of collections at home. What was meant to be just a walk often turned into a collection of items."
it: Prima si occupava di comunicazione nell'esercito di Zanan, poi ha deciso che non faceva per lei ed è passata a insegnare al Seminario. È una maniaca di oggetti, e si dice che in casa abbia collezioni d'ogni genere. Capita spesso che quella che doveva essere una passeggiata e basta finisca in una raccolta di oggetti.

jp: かつて冒険ゼミにお世話になった、いわば元卒業者。同じ講師のミトに不信感を持っており、いつ騙されて身ぐるみ剥がされるかわからない、と戦々恐々する毎日。一応、付けられたあだ名は気に入っている。
jp_grezzo: "かつて冒険ゼミにお世話になった、いわば元卒業者。同じ講師のミトに不信感を持っており、いつ騙されて身ぐるみ剥がされるかわからない、と戦々恐々する毎日。一応、付けられたあだ名は気に入っている。"
en: He is a former graduate of the Adventure Seminar so to speak. He has a distrust of a fellow lecturer Mito and every day he is torn between fear and fear that he will be duped and stripped to the ground at any moment. He likes the nicknames he's been given.
en_grezzo: "He is a former graduate of the Adventure Seminar so to speak. He has a distrust of a fellow lecturer Mito and every day he is torn between fear and fear that he will be duped and stripped to the ground at any moment. He likes the nicknames he's been given."
it: A suo tempo il Seminario d'Avventura lo ha avuto come allievo: insomma, è un ex diplomato. Non si fida di Mito, che insegna lì come lui, e passa le giornate col batticuore, aspettandosi da un momento all'altro di essere raggirato e ripulito di tutto. Il soprannome che gli hanno messo, a dire il vero, gli piace.

jp: 成長したカオス・スピリットが合体して半獣半蛇の魔物となった。製造プラントとしての役割を持ち、各部の球体は熟すと地面に落ちて無数のカオス・シードを生成する。嫌いなものはユニコーン。
jp_grezzo: "成長したカオス・スピリットが合体して半獣半蛇の魔物となった。製造プラントとしての役割を持ち、各部の球体は熟すと地面に落ちて無数のカオス・シードを生成する。嫌いなものはユニコーン。"
en: The chaos spirit that had grown up merged into a half-beast half-snake demon. Serving as a production base the spheres in each part fall to the ground as they ripen producing countless chaos seeds. What they hate are unicorns.
en_grezzo: "The chaos spirit that had grown up merged into a half-beast half-snake demon. Serving as a production base the spheres in each part fall to the ground as they ripen producing countless chaos seeds. What they hate are unicorns."
it: Nasce dagli spiriti del caos che, una volta cresciuti, si fondono in un mostro metà bestia e metà serpente. Ha il compito di fare da impianto di produzione: le sfere che porta sulle varie parti del corpo, quando maturano, cadono a terra e generano semi del caos a non finire. Quello che proprio non sopporta sono gli unicorni.

jp: 邪悪な神が、封印される間際に世界中にばら撒いた悪意の種。人間をマナごと取り込んで人型に成長していく。根絶やしにしようと神々が頑張っているが、潜伏するうえに増殖力が高いのでなかなか数が減らない。
jp_grezzo: "邪悪な神が、封印される間際に世界中にばら撒いた悪意の種。人間をマナごと取り込んで人型に成長していく。根絶やしにしようと神々が頑張っているが、潜伏するうえに増殖力が高いのでなかなか数が減らない。"
en: The seeds of malice that an evil god scattered throughout the world on the verge of being sealed. It takes in humans with mana and grows into a humanoid. The gods are working hard to eradicate them but their numbers don't decrease easily because they have a high ability to multiply in addition to hiding.
en_grezzo: "The seeds of malice that an evil god scattered throughout the world on the verge of being sealed. It takes in humans with mana and grows into a humanoid. The gods are working hard to eradicate them but their numbers don't decrease easily because they have a high ability to multiply in addition to hiding."
it: I semi di malanimo che un dio malvagio sparse per il mondo un attimo prima di essere sigillato. Si prende gli umani, mana compreso, e cresce fino alla forma umana. Gli dei si danno da fare per estirparli, ma stanno acquattati e si moltiplicano in fretta, così il loro numero non cala tanto facilmente.

jp: 世界一のプラチナ鉱山の持ち主。自分の鉱山から出たものが原型をとどめないほどに加工され、よく知らない人たちの手に渡り、使われるということに興奮する変人。自宅に趣味で大量のガチョウを飼っている。
jp_grezzo: "世界一のプラチナ鉱山の持ち主。自分の鉱山から出たものが原型をとどめないほどに加工され、よく知らない人たちの手に渡り、使われるということに興奮する変人。自宅に趣味で大量のガチョウを飼っている。"
en: The owner of the world's largest platinum mine. An eccentric who gets excited about the fact that something from his own mine has been processed to such an extent that it no longer resembles its original form and is now in the hands of people he doesn't know well. He keeps a large number of geese at home as a hobby.
en_grezzo: "The owner of the world's largest platinum mine. An eccentric who gets excited about the fact that something from his own mine has been processed to such an extent that it no longer resembles its original form and is now in the hands of people he doesn't know well. He keeps a large number of geese at home as a hobby."
it: Il padrone della più grande miniera di platino del mondo. Un tipo strambo che si entusiasma all'idea che quel che esce dalla sua miniera venga lavorato fino a non somigliare più a niente, passi in mano a gente che lui non conosce e finisca in uso da qualche parte. In casa alleva per passatempo una quantità di oche.

jp: 多くの死者を出した戦場などに生えた木が、死者の肉体、マナ、魂を余すところなく吸収した結果、強大な妖異と化した。怨念の集合体にして呪われた存在。
jp_grezzo: "多くの死者を出した戦場などに生えた木が、死者の肉体、マナ、魂を余すところなく吸収した結果、強大な妖異と化した。怨念の集合体にして呪われた存在。"
en: The trees that grew on the battlefields where many died absorbing the bodies mana and souls of the dead in their entirety became powerful demons. A cursed being made into a collection of grudges.
en_grezzo: "The trees that grew on the battlefields where many died absorbing the bodies mana and souls of the dead in their entirety became powerful demons. A cursed being made into a collection of grudges."
it: Gli alberi cresciuti sui campi di battaglia dove i morti si contavano a mucchi hanno assorbito dei caduti il corpo, il mana e l'anima senza lasciarne niente, e a furia di assorbire sono diventati una creatura mostruosa e potentissima. Un ammasso di rancore, e un essere maledetto.

jp: ドラゴンの格好よさに憧れた霊樹が、長年かけて自らの身体を変化させたもの。体表の緑色のコケに魔力を蓄えており、飛行も可能。長時間飛行する際は根の部分で土を掴んで持っていく。
jp_grezzo: "ドラゴンの格好よさに憧れた霊樹が、長年かけて自らの身体を変化させたもの。体表の緑色のコケに魔力を蓄えており、飛行も可能。長時間飛行する際は根の部分で土を掴んで持っていく。"
en: Having who longed for the good looks of a dragon it transformed its own body over the years. The green moss on its body surface stores magical power and it can also fly. When flying for long periods of time it holds on to soil by the roots and carries it along.
en_grezzo: "Having who longed for the good looks of a dragon it transformed its own body over the years. The green moss on its body surface stores magical power and it can also fly. When flying for long periods of time it holds on to soil by the roots and carries it along."
it: Un albero sacro che, ammirato da quanto sono belli i draghi, si è trasformato il corpo nel giro di lunghissimi anni. Nel muschio verde che ha in superficie accumula potere magico, e sa anche volare. Quando il volo si fa lungo, afferra un po' di terra con le radici e se la porta dietro.

jp: 争いの果てに木に変えられてしまった女神が、気の遠くなるほどの年月を経てどうにかほぼ人型にまで戻ってきた姿。もはや信仰心を集めるほどの力はなく、光合成しながら世間に八つ当たりする毎日。
jp_grezzo: "争いの果てに木に変えられてしまった女神が、気の遠くなるほどの年月を経てどうにかほぼ人型にまで戻ってきた姿。もはや信仰心を集めるほどの力はなく、光合成しながら世間に八つ当たりする毎日。"
en: A goddess who was transformed into a tree after a conflict but somehow managed to return to almost humanoid form after an unbearable number of years. She is no longer powerful enough to gather religious beliefs and every day she takes it out on the world while photosynthesizing.
en_grezzo: "A goddess who was transformed into a tree after a conflict but somehow managed to return to almost humanoid form after an unbearable number of years. She is no longer powerful enough to gather religious beliefs and every day she takes it out on the world while photosynthesizing."
it: Una dea che alla fine di una contesa fu ridotta ad albero, e che dopo un numero di anni da far girare la testa è in qualche modo tornata quasi alla forma umana. Non ha più la forza di raccogliere fede intorno a sé, e passa le giornate a prendersela col mondo mentre fa la fotosintesi.

jp: ハンノキの王。性格は邪悪そのものであり、人間を惑わして破滅へと導く。具体的には、馬で運ばれている最中の病気の子供に魔王として語りかけ、恐ろしい幻影を見せてショック死させるとか。
jp_grezzo: "ハンノキの王。性格は邪悪そのものであり、人間を惑わして破滅へと導く。具体的には、馬で運ばれている最中の病気の子供に魔王として語りかけ、恐ろしい幻影を見せてショック死させるとか。"
en: King of the ents. His personality is evil itself and he misleads and guides humans to their destruction. Specifically he talks to a sick child who is being carried on a horse as a demon king and gives him a terrifying vision and shocks him to death.
en_grezzo: "King of the ents. His personality is evil itself and he misleads and guides humans to their destruction. Specifically he talks to a sick child who is being carried on a horse as a demon king and gives him a terrifying vision and shocks him to death."
it: Il re degli ontani. Il carattere è la malvagità in persona: confonde gli uomini e li porta alla rovina. In concreto, per dire, parla come un re dei demoni al bambino malato che stanno portando via a cavallo, gli mostra visioni da far paura e lo fa morire di spavento.

jp: うねった複数の幹を持つ。幹を伸ばして歩き、その進路上にいるものを生きたまま取り込んで成長する。別名絞め殺しの木。幹がうねっているのは、取り込まれたものが最期に暴れるからだという。
jp_grezzo: "うねった複数の幹を持つ。幹を伸ばして歩き、その進路上にいるものを生きたまま取り込んで成長する。別名絞め殺しの木。幹がうねっているのは、取り込まれたものが最期に暴れるからだという。"
en: It has multiple trunks that are undulating. It walks with an outstretched trunk and grows by taking in the living in its path. Also known as the tree of strangulation. It is said that the reason the trunk is undulating is because the thing that has been taken in is violently struggling until the very end.
en_grezzo: "It has multiple trunks that are undulating. It walks with an outstretched trunk and grows by taking in the living in its path. Also known as the tree of strangulation. It is said that the reason the trunk is undulating is because the thing that has been taken in is violently struggling until the very end."
it: Ha più tronchi, tutti contorti. Cammina allungando i tronchi, e cresce inghiottendo vivo quello che gli capita sul percorso. Lo chiamano anche l'albero che strangola. Si dice che i tronchi siano contorti perché quel che ha inghiottito si dibatte fino all'ultimo.

jp: 人間に擬態した妖木。長髪で誤魔化しているが、化け切れておらず背中が完全に木。抱き寄せた時に背中が尋常じゃなくごつごつしていたり、木の枝が背中からはみ出している自称森ガールがいたら大体こいつ。
jp_grezzo: "人間に擬態した妖木。長髪で誤魔化しているが、化け切れておらず背中が完全に木。抱き寄せた時に背中が尋常じゃなくごつごつしていたり、木の枝が背中からはみ出している自称森ガールがいたら大体こいつ。"
en: A tree mimicking a human. Don't be misguided by her long hair she is not disfigured but her back is completely wooden. If there's a self-proclaimed forest girl whose back is unusually rough and branches are protruding from her back when she hugs you she' s usually this thing.
en_grezzo: "A tree mimicking a human. Don't be misguided by her long hair she is not disfigured but her back is completely wooden. If there's a self-proclaimed forest girl whose back is unusually rough and branches are protruding from her back when she hugs you she' s usually this thing."
it: Un albero-spettro che si finge donna. Si copre con i capelli lunghi, ma la trasformazione non le è riuscita fino in fondo e la schiena è rimasta tutta di legno. Se abbracciandola le senti la schiena ruvida in modo sospetto, o se ti capita una sedicente ragazza dei boschi a cui spuntano rami dalla schiena, quella nove volte su dieci è lei.

jp: 戦争に巻き込まれて妻を失ったため、戦争を根絶する手段を求め故郷を出奔。娘を連れて各地を放浪している最中、ヴァリウスと出会いその思想に共感した。娘と歩いていて兄妹に間違えられるのがちょっと嬉しい。
jp_grezzo: "戦争に巻き込まれて妻を失ったため、戦争を根絶する手段を求め故郷を出奔。娘を連れて各地を放浪している最中、ヴァリウスと出会いその思想に共感した。娘と歩いていて兄妹に間違えられるのがちょっと嬉しい。"
en: After losing his wife in the war he fled his hometown in search of a way to end the conflict. While wandering around the country with his daughter he met Vallius and sympathized with his ideas. I'm a little glad I'm walking with my daughter and being mistaken for a brother.
en_grezzo: "After losing his wife in the war he fled his hometown in search of a way to end the conflict. While wandering around the country with his daughter he met Vallius and sympathized with his ideas. I'm a little glad I'm walking with my daughter and being mistaken for a brother."
it: Perse la moglie travolto dalla guerra, e per questo lasciò il paese natale in cerca di un modo per sradicarla. Mentre girava di terra in terra con la figlia incontrò Barius, e ne condivise il pensiero. Quando cammina con la figlia e li scambiano per fratello e sorella, un po' gli fa piacere.

jp: 機械文明の最終戦争で使われた戦車。猫を思わせる程に運動性が高く、戦闘機や人型兵器を震え上がらせた。後継機は更なる超運動性を目指したが、敵への印象操作のためあえてマンモスと名付けられた。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明の最終戦争で使われた戦車。猫を思わせる程に運動性が高く、戦闘機や人型兵器を震え上がらせた。後継機は更なる超運動性を目指したが、敵への印象操作のためあえてマンモスと名付けられた。"
en: A tank used in the final war of a mechanical civilization. It was so agile that it reminded me of a cat and it made fighters and humanoid weapons tremble. Its successor aimed to be even more mobile but was purposely named Mammoth in order to fool the enemy.
en_grezzo: "A tank used in the final war of a mechanical civilization. It was so agile that it reminded me of a cat and it made fighters and humanoid weapons tremble. Its successor aimed to be even more mobile but was purposely named Mammoth in order to fool the enemy."
it: Un carro armato usato nella guerra finale della civiltà meccanica. Aveva una mobilità così alta da far pensare a un gatto, e faceva tremare i caccia e le armi dalla forma umana. Il modello che venne dopo puntava a una mobilità ancora più spinta, ma lo chiamarono apposta Mammut per far credere al nemico il contrario.

jp: 当初はペットロボットとして造られたが、やがて大型化され戦闘機獣として用いられるようになった。他の星から輸入された機械犬とこの星の機械犬の雑種がルーツ。激しく動くので性能を引き出すのは大変。
jp_grezzo: "当初はペットロボットとして造られたが、やがて大型化され戦闘機獣として用いられるようになった。他の星から輸入された機械犬とこの星の機械犬の雑種がルーツ。激しく動くので性能を引き出すのは大変。"
en: Initially built as a pet robot it was eventually enlarged to be used as a fighter beast. Rooted in machine dogs imported from other planets and a hybrid of machine dogs from this planet. It's hard to get the best performance out of it because it moves so violently.
en_grezzo: "Initially built as a pet robot it was eventually enlarged to be used as a fighter beast. Rooted in machine dogs imported from other planets and a hybrid of machine dogs from this planet. It's hard to get the best performance out of it because it moves so violently."
it: All'inizio fu costruito come robot da compagnia, poi lo ingrandirono e lo impiegarono come bestia da combattimento. Alla radice c'è l'incrocio fra i cani meccanici importati da altri pianeti e quelli di questo. Si muove in modo scomposto, e tirargli fuori tutto quello che sa fare è un'impresa.

jp: パワー・スピード・テクニックに優れ、自律行動で破壊と創造を繰り返す古代のモンスターマシン。当時の戦闘車両を真っ向から撃破したという記録も残っている。環境適応機能を持ち、劣悪な現場でもへっちゃら。
jp_grezzo: "パワー・スピード・テクニックに優れ、自律行動で破壊と創造を繰り返す古代のモンスターマシン。当時の戦闘車両を真っ向から撃破したという記録も残っている。環境適応機能を持ち、劣悪な現場でもへっちゃら。"
en: An ancient monster machine with superior power speed and technique it acts autonomously to destroy and reproduce repeatedly. It is also recorded that it defeated the fighting vehicles of the time head-on. It has an environment-adaptive function and can be used even in poor conditions.
en_grezzo: "An ancient monster machine with superior power speed and technique it acts autonomously to destroy and reproduce repeatedly. It is also recorded that it defeated the fighting vehicles of the time head-on. It has an environment-adaptive function and can be used even in poor conditions."
it: Un antico mostro-macchina che eccelle in potenza, velocità e tecnica, e che di sua iniziativa non fa che distruggere e ricostruire. Resta agli atti che sconfisse a viso aperto i veicoli da combattimento dell'epoca. Ha una funzione di adattamento all'ambiente, e anche nel peggiore dei cantieri non si scompone.

jp: 機械文明中期の量産型歩行マシン。頭部に人が乗り込める。機械信仰の素晴らしさを広めるプロパガンダに使われていたが、地味に軍用機並の頑丈さとアームの強さを誇る。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明中期の量産型歩行マシン。頭部に人が乗り込める。機械信仰の素晴らしさを広めるプロパガンダに使われていたが、地味に軍用機並の頑丈さとアームの強さを誇る。"
en: A mass-produced walking machine in the heights of a mechanical civilization. A person can get in the head. It was used for propaganda to spread the splendor of the machine but it also boasted the sturdiness and limb strength of a military-grade aircraft.
en_grezzo: "A mass-produced walking machine in the heights of a mechanical civilization. A person can get in the head. It was used for propaganda to spread the splendor of the machine but it also boasted the sturdiness and limb strength of a military-grade aircraft."
it: Macchina camminante di serie, della metà della civiltà meccanica. Nella testa ci sale una persona. La usavano per la propaganda che diffondeva le meraviglie del culto della macchina, ma vanta in sordina una robustezza da mezzo militare e braccia che non scherzano.

jp: 機械文明初期に使われていた主力兵器。装甲は薄いが軽量で小回りが利き、悪路にも強い。他の戦闘兵器が発達した後でも、かなりの数が自律回路を更新して長く運用されていたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明初期に使われていた主力兵器。装甲は薄いが軽量で小回りが利き、悪路にも強い。他の戦闘兵器が発達した後でも、かなりの数が自律回路を更新して長く運用されていたらしい。"
en: The main weapon used in the early days of mechanical civilization. Due to its thin armor it is lightweight and can be used for small turns and is reliable on rough roads. Apparently quite a few had been operating long after other combat weapons had been developed with updated autonomous circuits.
en_grezzo: "The main weapon used in the early days of mechanical civilization. Due to its thin armor it is lightweight and can be used for small turns and is reliable on rough roads. Apparently quite a few had been operating long after other combat weapons had been developed with updated autonomous circuits."
it: L'arma principale dei primi tempi della civiltà meccanica. La corazza è sottile, ma in cambio è leggero, gira stretto e se la cava anche sulle strade rotte. Pare che, anche molto dopo che le altre armi da combattimento si erano evolute, parecchi esemplari abbiano aggiornato i circuiti autonomi e siano rimasti in servizio a lungo.

jp: カブの仲間だが、大型でかなりの速度を出せる。カブと比べると寿命が短く、気難しくて荒っぽい。比較的手がかかるが、カブに慣れていてスピードを求めているのなら飼ってみてもいいだろう。
jp_grezzo: "カブの仲間だが、大型でかなりの速度を出せる。カブと比べると寿命が短く、気難しくて荒っぽい。比較的手がかかるが、カブに慣れていてスピードを求めているのなら飼ってみてもいいだろう。"
en: It's a member of the cubs but it's large and capable of considerable speed. It has a shorter lifespan than a cub and is grumpy and rough. It's a relative pain in the ass but if you're used to cubs and are looking for speed it's a good idea to keep one.
en_grezzo: "It's a member of the cubs but it's large and capable of considerable speed. It has a shorter lifespan than a cub and is grumpy and rough. It's a relative pain in the ass but if you're used to cubs and are looking for speed it's a good idea to keep one."
it: È della famiglia del Cub, ma è grossa e sa tirare fuori una bella velocità. Rispetto al Cub ha vita più breve, ed è permalosa e ruvida. Dà il suo daffare, ma se sei abituato al Cub e quello che cerchi è la velocità, tenerne una può valere la pena.

jp: 良くも悪くもまっすぐなエレアの青年。正義感の強かった亡き父に憧れ、森の自警団に所属していた。かつて各国の軍が森へ侵攻してきた際には、即席の妨害部隊を結成し最後まで地味に抵抗を続けていたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "良くも悪くもまっすぐなエレアの青年。正義感の強かった亡き父に憧れ、森の自警団に所属していた。かつて各国の軍が森へ侵攻してきた際には、即席の妨害部隊を結成し最後まで地味に抵抗を続けていたらしい。"
en: For better or worse this young man is a straightforward Elean. Admiring his late father who had a strong sense of justice he was a member of the forest vigilante group. In the past when armies from various countries invaded the forest they formed an impromptu interdiction squad and steadfastly resisted until the end.
en_grezzo: "For better or worse this young man is a straightforward Elean. Admiring his late father who had a strong sense of justice he was a member of the forest vigilante group. In the past when armies from various countries invaded the forest they formed an impromptu interdiction squad and steadfastly resisted until the end."
it: Un giovane Elea tutto d'un pezzo, nel bene e nel male. Ammirava il padre morto, che aveva un forte senso della giustizia, e stava nella ronda del bosco. Quando in passato gli eserciti di più paesi entrarono nel bosco, pare che abbia messo insieme su due piedi un reparto di disturbo e abbia continuato a resistere in sordina fino all'ultimo.

jp: 生化学文明期に使われていた最上級アンデッド兵器。現存しないものと思われていたが、最近エウダーナの古代遺跡から他の兵器を伴い現れた。ある女性が制御に成功するまで破壊の限りを尽くしたという。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明期に使われていた最上級アンデッド兵器。現存しないものと思われていたが、最近エウダーナの古代遺跡から他の兵器を伴い現れた。ある女性が制御に成功するまで破壊の限りを尽くしたという。"
en: A superlative undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. It was thought to be extinct but it recently emerged from the ancient ruins of Eulderna accompanied by other weapons. It is said that one woman went to great lengths to destroy it until she managed to get it under control.
en_grezzo: "A superlative undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. It was thought to be extinct but it recently emerged from the ancient ruins of Eulderna accompanied by other weapons. It is said that one woman went to great lengths to destroy it until she managed to get it under control."
it: L'arma non morta di grado più alto in uso ai tempi della civiltà biochimica. Si credeva che non ne esistessero più, ma di recente ne è comparsa una dalle rovine antiche di Eulderna, insieme ad altre armi. Si dice che abbia distrutto tutto quello che poteva finché una donna non è riuscita a tenerla a freno.

jp: 生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。単純戦闘力を重視したキングタイプと違い、後方支援を重視して造られた。知能がなかなか高く、サヴァントクイーンをライバル視して張り合う。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。単純戦闘力を重視したキングタイプと違い、後方支援を重視して造られた。知能がなかなか高く、サヴァントクイーンをライバル視して張り合う。"
en: An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. Unlike the King type which emphasized simple combat power the Queen type was built with an emphasis on logistical support. Her intelligence is quite high and she rivals the Savant Queen.
en_grezzo: "An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. Unlike the King type which emphasized simple combat power the Queen type was built with an emphasis on logistical support. Her intelligence is quite high and she rivals the Savant Queen."
it: Arma non morta di grado alto, in uso ai tempi della civiltà biochimica. A differenza del tipo re, tutto puntato sulla forza di combattimento pura, questa fu costruita puntando sul sostegno alle retrovie. È parecchio intelligente, e nella regina savant vede una rivale con cui misurarsi.

jp: 生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。人骨部分は近接武装をしているが、竜骨の背中にくっついている関係上格闘戦は苦手。どちらかというと制御ユニットとしての役割が大きいらしい。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。人骨部分は近接武装をしているが、竜骨の背中にくっついている関係上格闘戦は苦手。どちらかというと制御ユニットとしての役割が大きいらしい。"
en: An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. The skeleton is armed with melee weapons but it is not good at fighting because it is attached to the back of a dragon skeleton. If anything it seems to play a larger role as a control unit.
en_grezzo: "An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. The skeleton is armed with melee weapons but it is not good at fighting because it is attached to the back of a dragon skeleton. If anything it seems to play a larger role as a control unit."
it: Arma non morta di grado alto, in uso ai tempi della civiltà biochimica. La parte di ossa umane porta armi da mischia, ma stando attaccata alla schiena di uno scheletro di drago nel corpo a corpo se la cava male. Semmai, pare che conti soprattutto come unità di controllo.

jp: 生化学文明期に使われていた特殊アンデッド兵器。半霊体を無理やり屍人形に憑依させたもの。気味の悪い声で笑いながら戦場を滅茶苦茶にひっかき回す道化。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明期に使われていた特殊アンデッド兵器。半霊体を無理やり屍人形に憑依させたもの。気味の悪い声で笑いながら戦場を滅茶苦茶にひっかき回す道化。"
en: A special undead weapon that was used during the biochemical civilization. A half-spirit body is forcibly possessed by a corpse doll. A clown who scrambles around the battlefield laughing in a creepy voice.
en_grezzo: "A special undead weapon that was used during the biochemical civilization. A half-spirit body is forcibly possessed by a corpse doll. A clown who scrambles around the battlefield laughing in a creepy voice."
it: Arma non morta speciale, in uso ai tempi della civiltà biochimica. È un mezzo spirito costretto a impossessarsi di una bambola fatta di cadaveri. Un buffone che ride con una voce da far accapponare la pelle e mette il campo di battaglia sottosopra.

jp: イークの割には強い力と立派な勇気を持ち、イークの中でも英雄とされている者たち。集落を襲った猪を倒したり、腕試しに来た騎士と真っ向から戦ったりする。
jp_grezzo: "イークの割には強い力と立派な勇気を持ち、イークの中でも英雄とされている者たち。集落を襲った猪を倒したり、腕試しに来た騎士と真っ向から戦ったりする。"
en: They are considered heroes among the yeeks having strong power and admirable courage for a yeek. He defeats a boar that has attacked his village or fights head-on with a knight who has come to test his skills.
en_grezzo: "They are considered heroes among the yeeks having strong power and admirable courage for a yeek. He defeats a boar that has attacked his village or fights head-on with a knight who has come to test his skills."
it: Per essere uno yeek ha una forza notevole e un coraggio ammirevole, e fra gli yeek passa per eroe. Abbatte il cinghiale che ha assalito il villaggio, oppure affronta a viso aperto il cavaliere venuto a misurarsi con lui.

jp: 事故で人間並みの知性を手に入れたが、代償に理性が欠如したイーク。それゆえに悪魔や邪神の強大さに簡単に魅入られてしまった。他のイークたちからは、近寄るとヤバイやつだと認識されている。
jp_grezzo: "事故で人間並みの知性を手に入れたが、代償に理性が欠如したイーク。それゆえに悪魔や邪神の強大さに簡単に魅入られてしまった。他のイークたちからは、近寄るとヤバイやつだと認識されている。"
en: In an accident he gains human-level intelligence but at the cost of his mind losing his reason. That's why he was so easily enchanted by the mighty power of demons and evil gods. The other yeeks recognize him as a dangerous individual if he gets close to them.
en_grezzo: "In an accident he gains human-level intelligence but at the cost of his mind losing his reason. That's why he was so easily enchanted by the mighty power of demons and evil gods. The other yeeks recognize him as a dangerous individual if he gets close to them."
it: Uno yeek che per un incidente si è ritrovato un'intelligenza pari a quella umana, ma in cambio ci ha rimesso la ragione. Per questo si è lasciato incantare senza fatica dalla potenza dei demoni e degli dei malvagi. Gli altri yeek lo tengono per uno a cui è meglio non avvicinarsi.

jp: イークの古代種。種類関係なくイーク族を使役する能力を持つ。イークのイークによるイークのための国家を創る、という大層な野望を持っているが、具体的にどうすればいいのかまでは考えていない。
jp_grezzo: "イークの古代種。種類関係なくイーク族を使役する能力を持つ。イークのイークによるイークのための国家を創る、という大層な野望を持っているが、具体的にどうすればいいのかまでは考えていない。"
en: An ancient species of yeeks. It has the ability to employ yeek tribes regardless of type. He has grand ambitions to create a nation of yeeks by yeeks for yeeks but he doesn't even think about how to go about it concretely.
en_grezzo: "An ancient species of yeeks. It has the ability to employ yeek tribes regardless of type. He has grand ambitions to create a nation of yeeks by yeeks for yeeks but he doesn't even think about how to go about it concretely."
it: Specie antica degli yeek. Ha il potere di comandare la stirpe degli yeek, di qualunque tipo siano. Coltiva l'ambizione solenne di fondare uno stato degli yeek, per opera degli yeek e a vantaggio degli yeek, ma su come farlo davvero non ci ha ancora pensato.

jp: イークの古代種。拳銃が大好きであり、よくノリノリで人間のガンマンの真似をしている。拳銃は拾いもの。自分たちで作るほどの技術は持っていない。
jp_grezzo: "イークの古代種。拳銃が大好きであり、よくノリノリで人間のガンマンの真似をしている。拳銃は拾いもの。自分たちで作るほどの技術は持っていない。"
en: An ancient species of yeek. He loves guns and often imitates a human gunman. A handgun is scavenged. They don't have the skills to make it themselves.
en_grezzo: "An ancient species of yeek. He loves guns and often imitates a human gunman. A handgun is scavenged. They don't have the skills to make it themselves."
it: Specie antica degli yeek. Va matto per le pistole, e spesso, tutto entusiasta, fa il verso ai pistoleri umani. La pistola l'ha trovata per terra: la tecnica per costruirsela da solo non ce l'ha.

jp: イークの古代種。体が頑丈で力も強いが、他の生物に比べるとやはり劣る。そのためか現代では繁殖力が高く小型の種類のイークが台頭している。あまり群れようとしないが仲間意識は強い。
jp_grezzo: "イークの古代種。体が頑丈で力も強いが、他の生物に比べるとやはり劣る。そのためか現代では繁殖力が高く小型の種類のイークが台頭している。あまり群れようとしないが仲間意識は強い。"
en: An ancient species of yeek. Their bodies are strong and sturdy but they are not as strong as other creatures. Perhaps because of this small highly fertile species of yeek have emerged in modern times. They don't try to flock but they have a strong sense of camaraderie.
en_grezzo: "An ancient species of yeek. Their bodies are strong and sturdy but they are not as strong as other creatures. Perhaps because of this small highly fertile species of yeek have emerged in modern times. They don't try to flock but they have a strong sense of camaraderie."
it: Specie antica degli yeek. Ha il corpo robusto e anche la sua forza, ma messo accanto alle altre creature resta comunque indietro. Sarà per questo che oggi hanno preso il sopravvento le specie di yeek piccole e molto prolifiche. Non è tipo da branco, ma tiene molto ai suoi.

jp: 昔は酷いなまけものだった。しかし命がけでネフィアをひとつ攻略してから心機一転。冒険の楽しさに目覚め、今日も遺跡荒らしとして働いている。
jp_grezzo: "昔は酷いなまけものだった。しかし命がけでネフィアをひとつ攻略してから心機一転。冒険の楽しさに目覚め、今日も遺跡荒らしとして働いている。"
en: He used to be a terrible slob. However after risking his life to conquer one of the Nefian dungeons he had a change of heart. He has awakened to the joy of adventure and is still working as a ruins vandal today.
en_grezzo: "He used to be a terrible slob. However after risking his life to conquer one of the Nefian dungeons he had a change of heart. He has awakened to the joy of adventure and is still working as a ruins vandal today."
it: Un tempo era un pigrone da manuale. Poi ha conquistato una Nefia rischiando la pelle, e da lì ha cambiato registro. Si è risvegliato al piacere dell'avventura, e anche oggi è lì che lavora a saccheggiare rovine.

jp: 実家に縛られるのを嫌い幼い頃に家出。放浪中に誤って裏の業界へ踏み入ってしまうが、記憶力と洞察力で賭博に逆転勝利し生き残った。その後スリルを求めて裏の仕事に携わる中、一人の行き倒れに出会う。
jp_grezzo: "実家に縛られるのを嫌い幼い頃に家出。放浪中に誤って裏の業界へ踏み入ってしまうが、記憶力と洞察力で賭博に逆転勝利し生き残った。その後スリルを求めて裏の仕事に携わる中、一人の行き倒れに出会う。"
en: She ran away from home at an early age because she hated being tied to her parents' home. While wandering she accidentally ventured into the underworld but survived by winning the gamble to regain her memory and insight. Later while working behind the scenes in search of thrills he meets a man who has fallen.
en_grezzo: "She ran away from home at an early age because she hated being tied to her parents' home. While wandering she accidentally ventured into the underworld but survived by winning the gamble to regain her memory and insight. Later while working behind the scenes in search of thrills he meets a man who has fallen."
it: Non sopportava di stare legata alla casa di famiglia, e da piccola scappò via. Mentre girava senza meta mise per sbaglio piede nel giro losco, ma con la memoria e l'intuito ribaltò la partita al gioco d'azzardo e ne uscì viva. Poi, mentre si dava ai lavori sporchi per il gusto del rischio, si imbatté in una persona stramazzata per strada.

jp: 別名、クイックリングの仕事人。小さい体を活かして闇に紛れ、標的を待ち伏せする。そして糸を自在に操って目にもとまらぬ速さで標的を惨殺するのだ。その腕前は鮮やか。

en: Also known as a quickling workman. He uses his small body to blend in with the darkness and ambush his targets. He then manipulates the string to slaughter the target with uncanny speed. His skills are superb.

it: Lo chiamano anche il professionista dei quickling. Sfrutta il corpo piccolo per confondersi col buio e aspetta il bersaglio all'agguato. Poi manovra i fili come vuole e lo fa a pezzi a una velocità che l'occhio non segue. Un lavoro pulito.
